verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's Infrastructure Manager is a first-party service for defining infrastructure declaratively with Terraform, and it supports preview deployments before changes are applied. That covers the template/declarative part of the story. Preview is a dry-run-style check, not documented state management or rollback, and the pack shows no typed CDK-style framework. Missing for 10: typed CDK-style first-party framework, documented state/rollback semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, infrastructure is code on day one — a first-party IaC surface (templates plus a typed CDK-style framework) with documented state/rollback semantics

citations.quote: Define your infrastructure declaratively using Terraform.
Create preview deployments to see how changes affect your infrastructure before applying them.
